Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Lilybrook
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Portraits for Lilybrook Characters using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]'s style as a base + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt?gameId=1303]AhCuteArt[/url]'s Jinx portraits as a reference for Hazel!
[size=4]
[b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to navigate to your mod folder, find Lilybrook, and drag my "assets" folder into the [CP] Lilybrook folder, allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, then you're done! 
[size=4]
[b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI, Lilybrook & it's dependencies
